about.title: About us
about.story: Mada Sweet was established in 1989 in Kielce, Poland. Since the beginning of our activity, we have dealt with the import and distribution of impulse confectionery. Following the initial success in Poland, we created our own brands Johny Bee and X-Treme, which are now leading brands in the candy novelty category within the European Union. We manage the entire product development process — from the initial concept and ingredient selection to the final package design, offering a wide range of unique and patented products.
about.closing: We are proud of our creative team and our commitment to bringing sweet joy to children and families across the globe!
